stories.title: Legendary Lights returns to Stony Brook with nearly 400 decorated homes
stories.summary: A beloved Western New York holiday tradition is back. Legendary Lights has returned to Stony Brook with hundreds of decorated homes.

stories.title: Festival of Lights opens at Hamburg Fairgrounds with more than 70 displays
stories.summary: From the Whoville Express and Santa Claus to holiday lights and a silent disco, the Festival of Lights is lighting up the Hamburg Fairgrounds through Dec. 30.

stories.title: Which BPS closure plan will pass? At least one swing vote could push it in either direction
stories.summary: Park District Board of Education member Erik Bohen says he feels like his vote will swing the school closure plans one way or another during a special meeting Monday

stories.title: Difficult dilemma: Police encounter armed individuals with mental health or behavior issues
stories.summary: Union leaders are discussing the challenges officers face when balancing public safety, officer safety, and crisis intervention.

stories.title: Electrical fire damages roof at True Bethel Baptist Church in Buffalo
stories.summary: Buffalo firefighters responded to an electrical fire at True Bethel Baptist Church on Friday afternoon.

stories.title: Shoppers flood Walden Galleria mall for Black Friday deals
stories.summary: With the cost of living top of mind, many Western New Yorkers say Friday's retail holiday helps make the season a little more affordable.

stories.title: Burch has 130 yards rushing and a TD, Buffalo beats Arkon to clinch berth in MAC title game
stories.summary: Messiah Burch had 130 yards rushing and a touchdown on 24 carries, Jason Wright threw a 21-yard touchdown pass to Terrance Shelton Jr. and Buffalo beat Akron 17-9.

stories.title: Western New Yorkers kick off Christmas season with annual tree-cutting tradition
stories.summary: A holiday tradition since the 1960s, Jurek Trees continues to bring families together year after year to find their perfect Christmas tree

stories.title: New York State Senate Majority Leader Andrea Stewart-Cousins dies at 76
stories.summary: Additional details surrounding her death were not immediately available.

stories.title: LeRoy Police: 80-year-old woman killed after being hit by pickup truck Friday
stories.summary: Police say an 80-year-old woman was killed Friday in LeRoy after being struck by a pickup truck.

stories.title: Bills Mafia co-founder disappointed fans missed Goo Goo Dolls halftime show
stories.summary: The Goo Goo Dolls halftime set at Highmark Stadium in the rain was not shown during the national broadcast.

stories.title: Weather puts Canalside skating on ice, cancels Friday’s opening festivities
stories.summary: Ice at Canalside will remain closed Friday due to unfavorable weather conditions, according to Buffalo Waterfront.
